(2) Every `0.10.3` mention (`rg -n '0\.10\.3' docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/the-paseo-channel.md`: the spawn refusal text and its FIX line, the daemon-down FIX line, the doctor bare-version example, the paragraph `First, Paseo 0.10.3 is the minimum required version.
